definitions.explanation: A road within a city or town, especially one lined with buildings or trees. More formal than {道|みち} or {通|とお}り, and often used in urban planning or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {街路|がいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{植|う}えてある→植える：01210_ueru⟧。
examples.english: Cherry trees are planted along the street.

examples.japanese: {街路|がいろ}{樹|じゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}っている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: Fallen leaves from the roadside trees are covering the sidewalk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{街路|がいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}して→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧、⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遊歩道|ゆうほどう}→遊歩道：23484_yuuhodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれ{変|か}わらせる→生まれ変わる：13522_umarekawaru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Plans are underway to renovate old city streets and transform them into pedestrian-only promenades.

notes:
USAGE:
{街路|がいろ} is a somewhat formal word for streets within a city, commonly seen in compound words. It is more specific than ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road, path) or ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (street, avenue) and carries an urban connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街路|がいろ}{樹|じゅ} (roadside tree, street tree)
- {街路|がいろ}{灯|とう} (street light)
- {街路|がいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walk along a street)
- {街路|がいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧ (street maintenance/improvement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: road, path (general, any kind of route)
- ⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧: street, avenue (common, everyday word)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: road (official/administrative term)
